131export class MockPanel {
132  protected readonly control = inject(MockControl);
133  protected readonly tab = signal<Tab>('endpoints');
134  protected readonly tabs: { id: Tab; label: string }[] = [
135    { id: 'endpoints', label: 'Endpoints' },
136    { id: 'log', label: 'Request log' },
137  ];
138  private readonly dialog = viewChild.required<ElementRef<HTMLDialogElement>>('dialog');
139  private readonly host = inject<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>(ElementRef);
140 
141  protected open() {
142    this.dialog().nativeElement.showModal();
143  }
144 
145  protected switchTab() {
146    const next: Tab = this.tab() === 'endpoints' ? 'log' : 'endpoints';
147    this.tab.set(next);
148    queueMicrotask(() =>
149      this.host.nativeElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`#mock-tab-${next}`)?.focus(),
150    );
151  }
152}
